$comment: Editor RPC ops that older plugin releases may lack, each gated on a session-blob capability (web.md §4.1). scripts/compat/editor-compat.mjs accepts an op missing from a release only when the op is listed here, the release advertises a capability list without that capability, and the editor checks it with hasCapability(blob, '<capability>'). Shape: { "gates": { "<op>": { "capability": "<name>", "since": "<version>" } } }
